Testnet prototype · Mainnet-ready architecture

Safer agent actions, priced by the decision.

AlgoSentinel gives Algorand AI agents a paid ALLOW, REVIEW, or BLOCK decision before they transfer, swap, or accept an asset.

View the safety endpoints

How it works

Four steps, one HTTP round trip. Nothing to configure ahead of time.

01

Agent proposes an action

The agent sends its intended action and the relevant Algorand addresses or assets to AlgoSentinel.

02

Server returns 402

The endpoint responds with HTTP 402 Payment Required and the exact USDC payment details for the decision.

03

Agent pays in USDC

The agent signs a small USDC payment on Algorand and the GoPlausible facilitator verifies and settles it on-chain.

04

Agent receives a verdict

The paid response returns ALLOW, REVIEW, or BLOCK with machine-readable reasons before the agent acts.

Three decisions, one safety layer

Each check is independently priced and independently payable. Your agent can call one check or compose all three before acting.

Agent Preflight Decision

$0.003
POST /api/agent-preflight

A deterministic ALLOW, REVIEW, or BLOCK decision before an autonomous agent transfers, swaps, or calls a paid service.

curl -X POST https://api.blueprintstech.org/api/agent-preflight -H "content-type: application/json" -d '{"action":"swap","counterparty":"ALGO_ADDRESS"}'

Counterparty Verification

$0.001
POST /api/verify-counterparty

A paid counterparty check that turns Algorand account activity into a machine-readable transfer decision.

curl -X POST https://api.blueprintstech.org/api/verify-counterparty -H "content-type: application/json" -d '{"address":"ALGO_ADDRESS"}'

Asset Verification

$0.001
POST /api/verify-asset

Supply, metadata, and clawback/freeze control checks for an ASA or NFT before an agent accepts or transfers it.

curl -X POST https://api.blueprintstech.org/api/verify-asset -H "content-type: application/json" -d '{"assetId":"10458941"}'

Give your agent a safety gate

Wrap the HTTP client once. Payment and the safety decision happen inline.

import { wrapFetchWithPayment } from "@x402/fetch";
import { toClientAvmSigner } from "@x402/avm";

const signer = await toClientAvmSigner(process.env.AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY);
const pay = wrapFetchWithPayment(fetch, signer);

const res = await pay("https://api.blueprintstech.org/api/agent-preflight", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: { "content-type": "application/json" },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    action: "swap",
    counterparty: "ALGO_ADDRESS",
    assetId: "10458941",
  }),
});

const decision = await res.json();
console.log(decision.decision, decision.reasons);
